decision: A late metadata reply applies only while its item is still the shared player's actual current item and the newest request, including after something outside this owner replaced the item.

evidence.note: Haiku 5.5 failed 3/3 without skill content and 1/1 with; the identity guard read the owner's cached item instead of the player's actual current item, so external replacement was missed.

variants.why: Observes the player's currentItem and drops the pending lookup when the item changes elsewhere; tracks the pending item instead of a counter.
A single identity check against the player's actual current item covers both newer local starts and external replacement.
Observed mechanism: compares with the screen's own cached item, which an external replacement never updates.
Rejects replies superseded by this screen only; an external item replacement still lets the stale title through.
